title: Two-strand RNA splicing checks and Stage-0 donor comparators
summary: Adds a reproducible two-strand RNA-splicing and DNA-repeat scanner across the inserted donor sequences, registers shielded Stage-0 challenger comparators for Loci 1, 3 and 4, and enforces calibrated RNA recovery and host-gene boundary gates.

changes.text: A reproducible two-strand splice-motif, stop-seam, neo-site and overlapping/disjoint repeat census across all materialised donor templates, plus full-polypeptide reconciliation of the 326 Class-I and 112 Class-II boundary peptide windows (DEC-092, IIP-0015).

Synthesis-ready PAM/seed-shielded and unshielded Stage-0 challenger comparators across Locus 3 (synonymous PD-L1 recoding, bGH 3′-end check and optional single-sided 5′ cHS4 FII), Locus 4 (matched 2×2 orientation × A72T/C73A AAVS1 controls alongside retained SV40 poly(A) 3′-end checks) and Locus 1 (separated 505-aa Embodiment A* and 500-aa Arm 1B/1C stop-seam edits), leaving all canonical reference FASTAs unchanged.

Executable Stage-0 lab contract rules requiring calibrated RNA recovery standards, host-context EndoC-βH1 minigene screening, two-one-sided host-mRNA equivalence bounds with below-quantification holds, and non-pooled clonal UMI junction sequencing alongside intact Tier 6A/6B iCasp9 safety gates.

title: Post-gel immune rechallenge, CD55 complement check and held candidate gates
summary: Adds Stage-0 immune rechallenge tests after gel proteins wear off, an unconfounded ectopic CD55 complement satellite, and strict hold gates for four proposed gene edits.

changes.text: A blocked three-history sibling-aliquot rechallenge after verified loss of SA-FasL and SA-THBD bioactivity, with SA-FHL-1 truth-in-labeling and non-pooled aging-decay vs physical-washout histories (DEC-091, IIP-0012).
An unconfounded same-edited-background +/- ectopic CD55(SCR1-4) attribution satellite preserving endogenous CD59 and IRIS-1/2 insulin exocytosis.

Explicit HOLD_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_FALSIFIER transition gates holding TYMS, Design-B NLRC5, endogenous CD274 +6A>T and single-allele TXNIP ChoRE candidates outside all core constructs without changing Layer-1 scores.

title: Core knock-in safeguards, iCasp9 3D audit and donor TYK2 sweep
summary: Adds Stage-0 neighbouring-gene, splicing and methylation checks around Loci 1, 3 and 4, records the ZnT8 hold, audits three iCasp9 reference crystal structures, and publishes a 10,000-patient donor TYK2 sensitivity sweep.

changes.text: Stage-0 checks for CXCL9, CXCL11 and isoform-resolved ART3 around Locus 3, a four-arm AAVS1 UCOE orientation, splicing and CpG methylation comparison for Locus 4 alongside Arm 1B methylation tracking, and a precautionary hold on donor SLC30A8 knockout (DEC-090, IIP-0011).

Three pinned RCSB crystal structures (1BL4, 1JXQ and 1NW9) in Layer 3 auditing the FKBP12(F36V), Caspase-9 dimer and XIAP-BIR3 interfaces of Locus 4 iCasp9 while keeping full-fusion potency functional tests authoritative.
A 10,000-patient donor TYK2 rs34536443 sensitivity sweep (G/G, G/C and natural C/C) and provenance-only donor IFIH1 rs1990760 tracking in Layer 5.

title: Evidence base expanded to 1,151 studies in the Context–Evidence Graph
summary: Publishes the 1,151-study Type 1 Diabetes Context–Evidence Graph (7,659 groups, 14,105 structured outcomes and 2,447 blueprint links) across the website, downloads and MCP connector while keeping the 563-study scoring baseline explicit.

changes.text: Published the Type 1 Diabetes Context–Evidence Graph (1,151 primary empirical studies, 7,659 experimental and control groups, 14,105 structured outcomes and 2,447 blueprint links, screened from 3,922 candidate records; DEC-089) as an open CC BY 4.0 download and as the new 'evidence' layer in get_layer_atlas.
Documented the explicit separation between the 1,151-study Context–Evidence Graph and the 563-study design-scoring baseline so adding structured literature does not silently shift model scores.

title: Oxygen-release half-life tested across each peroxide recipe
summary: Reclassifies the 68-hour oxygen-release half-life as an unvalidated per-recipe target and publishes an 84-run sensitivity sweep across both peroxide microbead recipes.

changes.text: Labelled the 68.0-hour oxygen-release half-life as a formulation-specific reference target rather than a fixed material constant, and added particle-size placeholders and Stage-0 qualification gates for each CaO2:PDMS recipe (DEC-088, IIP-0010).
An 84-run fixed-inventory sensitivity sweep across half-lives from 24 to 130 hours, three release laws and two blood-vessel connection times for both the 31.25 wt% and 46.39 wt% recipes.
Stopped DOIs with long digit strings from triggering a false phone-number warning in the submission checker.

title: Design X's scored edit and Stage-0 upgrades mapped clearly apart
summary: Marks every Design X mention across the blueprint, tissue simulations and open questions as either the scored insulin-gene edit or the unscored Stage-0 upgrade bundle.

changes.text: Added an explicit mapping in Layer 4, the blueprint and the connector (DEC-087, IIP-0009) distinguishing the scored Design X grid row (119 µm oxygen layer) from the unscored Stage-0 upgrade bundle (100 µm oxygen layer and outer-ring Fas-ligand gel).
Widened open question OQ-015 across Designs A, B and X because all three share the 119 µm baseline oxygen layer in the scored grid.
Stopped negated design names such as '(not Design B)' from adding extra design labels in the submission checker.

title: CD47 study models and density threshold separated accurately
summary: Reclassifies Xu 2024 to its actual non-islet models, removes it from rule GY-009, and separates Hu 2023's primary human islet CD47 threshold from its stem-cell islet counts.

changes.text: Reclassified Xu 2024 (PMID 38508139) from stem-cell islets to four non-islet immune, blood-stem-cell and endothelial models at Tier 2B (DEC-086, IIP-0008), moving Design A's overall score from 0.1085 to 0.1084.

Removed Xu 2024 from Idea Graveyard rule GY-009 and added a separate primary human islet arm to Hu 2023 (PMID 37156915) for the 180,000 to 220,000 CD47 molecules-per-cell transition measured with clone CC2C6 and Quantibrite beads.

title: Open question on combined human immune–islet testing at Stage 1
summary: Adds open question OQ-017 on whether a combined human immune and islet co-culture at Stage 1 can catch cross-talk between immune cell types that split Stage-0 tests miss.

changes.text: Open question OQ-017 and a Stage-1 qualification note beside Readout 3 (DEC-085, IIP-0007), while keeping split Stage-0 Readouts 3A, 3B and 3C separate and mandatory.

title: Testing cell mixes with a bigger share of insulin-making cells
summary: Adds a staged lab comparison of cell mixes between the current 60:30:10 recipe and insulin-cells-only controls, to see whether any lowers tissue volume or oxygen need without weakening protection against low blood sugar.

changes.text: A staged lab comparison in Readout 2 and the HIP-Core protocol (DEC-084, IIP-0006) of four in-between beta:alpha:delta cell recipes (70:20:10, 70:25:5, 80:15:5 and 80:10:10) against the 60:30:10 recipe and the insulin-cells-only controls.

A rule that any candidate recipe must be confirmed in fresh batches, for both insulin shut-off and low-sugar glucagon rescue, before anyone claims a smaller implant dose. The 60:30:10 recipe stays the default unless new measurements justify a change.

title: Testing whether liquid from the cells can calm immune cells
summary: Adds a controlled lab screen to check whether protective PD-L1 protein released by the engineered islet cells into the surrounding liquid is biologically active, not just present.

changes.text: A staged lab test in Readout 3A and Locus 3 (DEC-083, IIP-0005) that checks whether cell-free liquid collected from around the engineered islet cells slows down a separately triggered immune response.
Controls for filter loss and leftover inflammatory signals so a positive or negative lab result cannot be confused with lingering test chemicals or lost particles.

title: Working well after the low-oxygen window
summary: Cells that survive the 14-day low-oxygen window after transplant are now checked for normal insulin and glucagon release before the working dose is counted.

changes.text: A side-by-side lab test of insulin and glucagon release during and after recovery, telling lost cells apart from weakened ones.
A new decision, DEC-082, records the change.

title: The odds now say exactly what they measure
summary: The rough odds on the Blueprint page now define each step, give the reason for each hurdle's three-design figure, and name the checks that sit outside the four hurdles.

changes.text: Each hurdle figure is now a judgement for a design still in the running, given it cleared the earlier hurdles. The 21% and 37% are unchanged.
One reason per hurdle for its three-design figure, in the full blueprint.
A new open question, OQ-016, on how the odds are built and which success they estimate.
Section 3 and Table 3 now say which score they show and which score the rank uses.
The starter pack now includes Table 3, the model scores.

title: Oxygen supply tested under late and weak blood vessels together
summary: Blood vessels that connect late and vessels that carry less oxygen than hoped are now tested together, and the whole grid is published.

changes.text: A joint test of when the blood vessels connect (36 to 60 hours in 4-hour steps, plus 96 and 168 hours as stress tests) and how well they carry oxygen, under both of the model's oxygen-release laws, with unrounded results and a finer-mesh check of the closest calls.
An exact no-blood-vessel lower bound: what the cells get with no vessels at all.
A table of where each setting in the test comes from.
The timing axis is now labelled as the target midpoint; the realised half-way point comes about 3 hours later.
The Python requirement is now numpy 2.0 or later, which the Layer 4 code needs (it crashed on older versions).
